introduced.where: Section 3, 'Use / Sanity check' paragraph immediately after Theorem 3.1 (Tree covering)
introduced.quote: the theorem says that a random set of density $O(\sigma\log\ell_1)$ contains one of them with probability $\frac23$
introduced.problem: Minor imprecision in an added sanity check. The theorem gives density 16e^{50}σ(1+log_2 ℓ_1), i.e. O(σ(1+log ℓ_1)), and probability at least 2/3. For ℓ_1=1 the expression O(σ log ℓ_1) is zero, and a density-0 set cannot contain a nonempty label, so the paraphrase is literally false in that case; it is correct for ℓ_1≥2. No proof depends on this sentence.
